entries.text:
Damn site terminal is acting up again!

I've asked Nathan to contact Tim again to come out tomorrow and get it fixed for Monday. Last time I remember this happening, Tim mentioned something about "bugs" in the machine? No idea how bugs are getting into the machine but we seriously need to sort this out. I have to use Nathans terminal AGAIN!

I seriously need to get September's casualty report ready for this weeks monthly report! I hope this site gets automated soon or so help me God, if management send me more idiots disguised as workers, I'm going to go mad!

entries.title: Employee Report
entries.text:
Employee Report
---------------------
Reason for Report: Anti-social Behavior/Possible Communist Sympathizer 
-----------------------------------------------------
Employee Name: Harold Osborne

Mr. Osborne is a recent employee, having joined the company 5 months ago. He was hired as a general laborer, helping construct and maintain the gas extraction platform. A quiet individual, normally keeping to himself however, has lately started to completely ignore his co-workers unless he is being given a task to complete.



Within the last few weeks, he has been spotted climbing up to the top of the tower rather frequently during his shifts. One employee stated they had witnessed him at the top of the tower during the weekend, when the site was meant to be closed.

When confronted with these accusations Mr. Osborne is stated on record saying that they are untrue and that he is a true patriot. It is unclear why he immediately alluded to patriotism, but has been flagged by management as evidence that Mr. Osborne may be a Communist Sympathizer. 

Management has requested that we keep a close eye on him and to contact the proper authorities if we find any definitive proof of Mr. Osborne's sympathies.

entries.title: Operation Sleeping Giant
entries.text:
ATTENTION: LET SLEEPING GIANTS LIE

Operation Sleeping Giant Information:
-------------------------------------

The following is an overview of a social experiment approved by the DIA, to be actioned 2076-2077.

Experiment Overview:
---------------------

The goal of Operation Sleeping Giant is to prove the effectiveness of communist brainwashing on US citizens in order to develop countermeasures..

Camp Liberty in Shenandoah National Park has been chosen to serve as the site for the test due to its proximity to [REDACTED], where operational data will be analyzed.

Conditioning:
---------------------

Children attending the camp will be shown films containing hidden messaging. These have been created by the DIA for this test but are in line with what we believe the Reds are already using. Social conditioning and suggestion tactics will also be used by the on-site staff.

Once they leave the camp, subjects will be monitored to assess long-term impact of their indoctrination. Surveillance details and timeframes are on a need-to-know basis.

Once concluded, surviving subjects will be brought in for debriefing to reverse the conditioning following standard procedures.

Activation Phrases:
---------------------

LET SLEEPING GIANTS LIE

Places the subject in a suggestive state for conditioning. It can also be added to sensitive materials to prompt the subject to ignore what they see.

THE SLEEPING GIANT HIBERNATES IN THE SUMMER

[REDACTED]

THE SLEEPING GIANT GAINS SUSTENANCE FROM THE BERRY

[REDACTED]

THE SLEEPING GIANT AWAKES TO FIND AN UNHAPPY WORLD

Re-activates the subject's camp training and conditioned state.

entries.title: Re-Education Program
entries.text:
Re-Education Program
---------------------

Comrades! To help build our army we need as many recruits as we can possibly take. The council have suggested doing a re-education program. 

The re-education program will consist of capturing capitalist Americans and putting them in holding cells back at the camp. Over the course of a couple of days, we will use our educational films, along with other methods, to show them the truth.

Ones who are receptive to the re-education process will join our ranks as brothers and sisters under the cause. The ones who fail will be terminated.

entries.title: Storm
entries.text:
In the Wake of the Storm
-------------------------

The camp has sustained substantial damage from the storm. With the defensive wall, bunkhouse, and several other buildings all in need of significant repairs. We have never seen anything like it.

While the bunkhouse is repaired, we have relocated some comrades to the "wild camping zone" as a temporary measure. They are enjoying the change of pace and see it as an opportunity to strengthen their resolve. We have provided counselors with advanced reading materials as a reward.

The operation continues.

entries.title: Stoney Man Tower Notes
entries.text:
Assault on Stoney Man Tower
----------------------------

When it comes the matter of expansion, as raised in the last council meeting, I have concluded that Stony Man Lookout is the most logical starting point.

The mutants have proven resistant to our messaging and regularly attack the camp. Taking over the Lookout would deal with the mutant problem once and for all. We would also gain a valuable strategic asset: a clear view of the immediate area from which to plan our next moves.

I need to plan the mission, only then can I petition to the council. Getting them to give it the go ahead should not be a problem. As a senior officer for the old regime, I carry significant sway with the them, and we have many able-bodied soldiers willing to die for the cause. This is a chance to show our strength and begin our glorious mission.

entries.title: Brown House Notes
entries.text:
Searching the Brown House
--------------------------

Rapidan Camp is another key target for future expansion. A retreat for the former capitalist pig in chief, President Hoover, it has everything we need. Aside from the dusty old books and antiques, it has multiple secure buildings. I also remember seeing military personnel when we visited the camp in the summer before the war. Before I was shown the truth.

It is likely that there are weapons and military equipment in the camp. Better yet, there could even be maps and documents that will lead us to other facilities in the region. If all goes well it will secure our presence in the area for years to come.

I will petition the council at the first opportunity.

entries.title: We did it!
entries.text:
It's taken a lot of manpower and a hell of a lot more grit, but we've finally managed finish the damn dam! No more sitting in the dark reading Grognak and jump at everything that goes bump in the night!

Now that we have electricity, we can start focusing on other things like setting up a water pump for the crops. Things are coming together finally!

entries.title: Honest work!
entries.text:
We knew it wouldn't be easy, but we've now finally gathered everything we need to get the water pump working. We nearly lost a few people when scavenging up north, Phil nearly lost a hand to one of those a giant scorpions. Creepy looking bastards those things are.

Each time we've gone up north we've noticed more and more of those freaky green crystal guys, which makes it more difficult to sneak around. If they ever migrate south, though, we should be safe. We're fairly hidden away, but worst case scenario we cut the bridges, lift the elevator and hold them out.

Anyway, enough "what ifs", we've got crops to plant!

entries.title: We're not alone!
entries.text: We've spotted people! Real living human beings! (Although some appear like they've seen better days.) Some of us went stag hunting and heard a gunshot about a mile or so from our usual spot. We thought it might have been those freaks from up north finally migrating south, so we kept our distance just to be safe but eventually we spotted them. Seems that the people are finally returning home!

entries.title: Raiders?
entries.text: Since we found this place, we've been alone. The only signs of human life we had seen for the last few years was ourselves. At first we thought seeing people again was a blessing, but we forgot that with people they brings the good and the bad. Some really suspicious looking people have been snooping around the area near the firewatch tower. We've started to stock up on defenses just in case.

entries.title: Big green and mean?
entries.text: Heard a weird rumor about some "giant green guys" spotted in the distance. It'd be great if those rumors stayed rumors. Not sure how much worse it can get around here, especially with the dam starting to run dry... Guess we'll see what happens next.

items.contents:
Dear prospective merchant,

This contract will outline the terms of your collaboration with Milepost Zero, a branch of the Blue Ridge Caravan Company.

A starter package will be available for purchase from your operations manager. Further benefits of working for Milepost Zero are stated below:

- Exclusive access to Milepost Zero and (in limited capacities) BRC Co. suppliers.

- Exclusive stables for care of your Brahmin, under expert management of a stable master.

- Rights to open a stall within a Milepost Zero marketplace.

- Lodging accommodations and 2 meals a day at cost value.

Along with these benefits, your caravan will be assigned a guard in exchange for a commission fee.

In signing this contract, you agree to uphold the name and brand of Milepost Zero and its affiliate the Blue Ridge Caravan Company. You agree to pay all upkeep fees in full at the end of each month. In the event of your untimely demise, your next of kin will be given one month after the time of your death to retrieve your personal belongings, or they will be forfeited to Milepost Zero. As a representative of the company, you are prohibited from trading with outside suppliers. Goods obtained through illegitimate business will result in a forfeit of this contract and said goods remaining within the possession of Milepost Zero.

We look forward to years of success together!

Signature:

items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Theodore,

If you're reading this... If you're even still alive, I've rejoined Blue Ridge. That's right, they're still kicking.

I don't know what happened or why you never came back. I'm sure you had your reasons, and I need to do what's best for Marley. She has your eyes, and your stubbornness. I wish you could have seen her grow into the strong woman she is today. I know you would have been so proud. I'm sure you'll have as many questions as do I, hopefully in time they can all be answered.

If this letter ever reaches you, we've traveled to the new BRC Co. headquarters at the Big Bend Tunnel. Please be careful, the world is not the same as it was.

I love you, always.

Ineke!

I have a special request for you. Have you heard of "hanbok?" It's a garb worn by the people of Joseon (that's the old word for Korea, I think!).

My grandfather had a very nice one he wore every chuseok (that's our Thanksgiving!)

It's fallen into disrepair, but do you happen to have any similar fabric? Do you sew? Can you fix it for me? I will pay you in a variety of very pretty Cryptid bones.

Actually, do you think you could attach those to the outfit in some way?

Anyway, thanks in advance!

- Windy

Camp Diary
October 24, 2077
Sunday

Dear Diary,
I made it to the camp last night, a bit shaken up but in one piece. I was greeted at the front by the camp counselors and some well-dressed men in suits. We explained the situation that transpired on the bus as well as the large explosion we saw. Two of the counselors were sent out to go help Mr. Mitchell who was still on the bus, while the others explained to us that they thought the explosion could have been a nuclear blast.

The well-dressed men left the camp shortly after we arrived due to losing contact with someone over the radio. The rest of us have been told to stay put and not leave the camp until help arrives. The counselors have been left in charge for the time being.

I am currently sharing a tent with some kids from the other scout group who have been here for a couple of days now. They are acting very strange and talking about weird topics I don't like. I assume it might just be nerves which is why they are acting odd. But some of the conversations they have freak me out.

The camp counselors are putting on a movie for us all to watch before bedtime, so I'm going to end the diary here tonight. I do hope my family are safe and I get to see them soon.

July 29, 2104
Tuesday

Dear Diary,
Today marked an unusually boring start to my day as I found myself assigned to the worst role possible: guard duty at the prison. While I sat there at my post, one of those capitalist insects walked over to the fence. A young girl with brown hair and a revolting knife scar tracing down her left eye (likely a captive from a Raider camp). She approached the fence and initiated a conversation with me. She bluntly inquired, "What led you to this path?" My immediate response was to command her to quit talking and return to her place, which she did with clear reluctance.
[pagebreak]
Her words stayed in my mind throughout the remainder of my shift. I couldn't help but think about the reasons behind my unwavering commitment to our cause. I've always believed, deep down, that our mission serves a greater purpose and paves the way for a brighter future. But I had never taken the time to truly question why I stood where I did. So, I thought writing down my reasoning here in my diary might be good for future reference.

Why wouldn't I desire a communist utopia? What has capitalism ever done for me, or the nation as a whole?

Capitalism stole my parents away from me. The government's greed and refusal to cooperate with China initiated the catastrophic war that ultimately claimed the lives of those dearest to me.
[pagebreak]
Capitalism replaced the hardworking people of this very state with cold, unfeeling robots. Generations of families who had slaved away in mines and various industries for years were callously discarded and replaced in an instant with cheap robotic help.

The privileged capitalist elite sought refuge in bunkers while the majority of hardworking citizens, who had empowered them, either perished or suffered through the nightmarish aftermath they left behind.

Should that boorish woman ever ask me again, I now have my answers. I am prepared to lay down my life for this cause, to fight for the creation of a new world from the ashes of the old one, a world designed for the many and not just the few. Our nation can be rebuilt and restored to its former greatness under this ideology.
[pagebreak]
I have never felt more certain about anything in my life than I do about this. Exhausted after my grueling 12-hour shift, I'm now leaving my diary here for the night. There's still the task of preparing food for tomorrow to attend to.

items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Lady of the Lake

In the very heart of Shenandoah, nestled beside an old lake, exists a camp steeped in legend. This place, once a sanctuary of joyful memories, now harbors countless tales of sorrow and regret. None more heartbreaking than the story of Amelia Huntsman, a name when spoken, evokes dread into the most seasoned camper.

Amelia or "The Lady of the Lake" as she is better known as, arrived at this cursed campsite many years ago. Her innocent smile and innocent nature was a facade concealing her true hidden motive. Amelia attempted to strike a Faustian bargain with an uncontrollable power which has always been and always remains, trapped in these very hallowed grounds. This bargain as we have all come to know, would ultimately seal her fate.

Operation "Sleeping Giant" has been set up to investigate the effects of communist radicalization and brainwashing on children. We believe that the communist state could use this method & tactic to gain a foothold in this country via creating sleeper cells.

The goal of the operation is to test the potency of brainwashing along with the short-term and long-term effects it has on sleeper agents over 5 to 50 years.

We have secured a camp located in the Shenandoah National Park where the experiment will take place (away from public eyes). There will be at least one agent at the site at all times.

Reports need be sent back to headquarters on a monthly basis.

items.name: Prison Incident Report
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Title: Prison Break
Reporting Officer: S. Briggs
Location: Correctional Facility

Incident Details:
Three inmates attempted to escape from the prison. They successfully pried open the floorboards using concealed tools, subsequently attempting to tunnel their way out through the foundation of the prison. The discovery of this plot was made during a routine bunk inspection when contraband tools were found hidden beneath one inmate's pillow. After a private "conversation" with the inmate in question, they disclosed the identities of their co-conspirators, all of whom have since been appropriately dealt with.

Outcome:
The inmate who cooperated by revealing their fellow conspirators was placed in the secure inner holding cell, while the other two inmates were transferred to the Island and the Range, which follows established procedures.
[pagebreak]
Next Steps:
We must increase the frequency of our inspections and implement a policy of separating groups exceeding two individuals to prevent such incidents from recurring. We must also fix the security flaw in the back corner before we get any new arrivals.

Grounds Supervisor,
Gumley.

My name's Harry Edwards, and if you're reading this, odds are I am dead. Soon after the bombs rained down on us, my dear wife took a turn for the worse, and, well, she's in a better place now. This left me with nothing but a hole in my heart & endless grief, my only lifeline left in this world was my stepson, Thomas.

The issue is that Thomas was off on a trip with his camping group when the bombs came down. I've been tirelessly making my way down to Shenandoah Park for god knows how many weeks now, unsure if my boy is still alive. I keep pushing forward, fueled by a hope that he's out there, safe and sound.
[pagebreak]

I have no right to ask, but I beg of you from the bottom of my heart, if you know what it means to be a parent and to love them so deeply your own life means nothing in comparison to theirs. Help Ease the regret off this dead man's shoulders and head to the campground for me. If by some miracle, Thomas is alive, please SAVE MY SON.

Sincerely,

-Luca Costa

items.name: Harvester Risks

location.text: Found near Thunder Mountain Substation TM-03.

items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
While I am thrilled to be given the opportunity to see one of my creations come to life, I am startled and frankly concerned at the lack of safety & foresight my employers have shown.

My decision to use silver wiring was twofold; silver has high conductivity for electricity & heat, which means greater control over the heat generation sequence.
[pagebreak]
Unfortunately, I was under the impression these were prototypes; use of silver wiring introduces a serious long-term risk. Silver tarnishes far quicker than copper and thus becomes more unstable with use. The tarnished wires will eventually cause more resistance & heat, putting the integrity of the structures in jeopardy. Who knows how long these machines can last without regular wire replacements? A year? Maybe two?
[pagebreak]
Speaking of the heat generation, my second concern is with the venting chambers in the control bunker. They are exceptionally unorthodox; why would empty, unshielded rooms around the batteries aid the heat dissipation process that is designed to direct the heat into the ground? Those venting rooms are dangerous and should have the absolute minimum of human interaction, in my opinion. I was taken aback by the Overseer's insistence we use his old colleague's cooling design rather than my original one.
[pagebreak]
Not that anyone else seems to share my misgivings, of course. The Overseer wanted the most efficient machines possible and spared no expense, yet gave no thought to any of these concerns when I pressed the matter.  I was told a method of testing and disrupting the results of the "machine" could be of vital importance in the future. A machine they will not let ME look at, mind. Precious "Audrey" continues to receive special treatment while the minds of my ilk are put to use on busy work.
[pagebreak]
I also overheard something about the "obfuscation", which can only lead me to believe their pathetic attempts to disguise this place as a regular power substation has actually had some thought behind it. Whoever thought this would be passable should be put in one of those chambers during the next test run.

items.name: Notes on Lightning Harvesters

location.text: Found near Thunder Mountain Substation TM-03.

items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
As the mind responsible for the prototype, I feel it would be remiss of me to leave the workings behind these wondrous contraptions a mystery, so I have taken the liberty of writing a high-level overview of how this Lightning Harvester works.

Assuming all internal systems are normal and operational, initializing the Harvester's boot protocol will start the Storm Disruption Process.
[pagebreak]
During a cycle of heating & cooling, water droplets in the atmosphere become larger, inevitably rubbing against one another which causes friction and generates electricity. The harvester supplements this by discharging small amounts of electricity, using reserves kept from the last cycle.
[pagebreak]
This should lead to an increase in lightning strikes within the area - likely in a spectacular but dangerous fashion.

The Harvesters, however, are designed to be struck by lightning; when this happens they retain the charge from the lightning strike and store its energy in the custom silver-cored battery reservoirs built into the base of the harvester.
[pagebreak]
Alternatively, if needed, the machine can be set to send electricity directly back toward the Vault's various research departments.

Once sufficient energy has been gathered, the Storm Dissipation Cycle can be activated.

items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Blessed be, the Holy Mothman!
Praise unto the Prophet Alex!

Let His divine buzzing guide us through the darkness of this New World! Let her divine guidance show us to the Light that will call him.

My brothers and sisters, we find ourselves far from the Holy Land, far into these untamed lands. Deep into these dark tunnels.
[pagebreak]
Yes, I know, our home is far from us but do not let that weaken your resolve! The Prophet Alex has shown us a flame to kindle our spirit, to draw his embrace. We suffer down here in pursuit of her guidance!
[pagebreak]
Remember, that when your heart bleeds with sorrow, you bleed for Him! This is but a new chapter in our journey, as His children it is our duty to spread his word across the land! To create the Light that will signal unto him a land ready for his dusty shadow.
[pagebreak]
Follow Prophet Alex's Light!
Pray with me now, my mothling siblings!
Praise be, His elegant fuzz!
We offer this to you!
Our blood for you. THEIR blood for you!

Blessed be, the Holy Mothman!

items.contents:
It all started while chatting with some fellas in the crew I was running with.

None of us were really feeling the Raider lifestyle, so we broke out some drinks, got to talking about the past. About the park. Apparently, they used to have homes down here, a few years before the bombs fell. They told me about who stole it all from them. Left them all for dead.

None other than the man himself: Stolz.
[pagebreak]
We started scheming right there. One guy said he used to be in with this group of cultists. Said they were damn near unstoppable if they had a goal. We just needed to figure out what kind of flame would draw in their Mothy gaze... Because they believe in a giant holy moth - I didn't mention that yet.

Going to loot the local bookstore. See if I can read up a bit on this local legend. My new buddy thinks I've got a way with words, that I might be able to convince them that I'm some sort of heaven-sent prophet.
[pagebreak]
I know the light at the end of my tunnel: Turning that damn mansion into Hugo's funeral pyre, and Audrey's bright beaming face as I rescue her.

Now I just need them to follow me there. Praise the moth guy!

entries.title: February
entries.text:
I've finally managed to get this old terminal working. I "stole" it from the old park ranger office upstairs but this thing was practically junk, so sadly whatever was on it before has been lost to time.

We arrived here a few days ago and it seems there's been a few previous residents over the years, someone even took the time to taxidermy a whole new collection of animals in the displays! There's 10 of us here and as far as we know, this place is ours for now.

It'll be nice to sleep with a roof over my head, even better knowing that we're secure at least down in this basement. It even comes with beds!

entries.title: May
entries.text:
We've been situated in this old visitor center for a few months now and we've managed to keep our heads low from any unwanted parties. Seems we weren't the only ones that have set up shop in Shenandoah. And I don't mean the "ghost of a park ranger" that people claim sneaks around in the tunnels here at night.

A few of us went to explore the western side of the park, but the wildlife around here is too dangerous for long treks. Those giant birds could make quick work of us if we're not careful.

entries.title: September
entries.text:
Archie and his kid came hobbling into my office today with William's toe in a rag. Dumb kid had been playing around with his gun again, thinks himself some kind of post-apocalyptic cowboy.

Seems reality bit him real good in the form of a bullet to the foot. Guess that's what you get when you insist on using a crusty old revolver.

Got him patched up, but the toe couldn't be saved. Archie joked about making it into a pendant like a rabbit's foot, but I don't think his son was too happy about it.

entries.title: November
entries.text:
We lost Hendricks today.

Him, Skirving, and Redwood were out on a scavenging mission out near Watoga when they got caught in the crossfire between some kind of Ghouls and those big mutants. Skirving said the Ghouls looked "messed up" and had some kind of huge bat-like creature helping them. Skirving described that it would "burp up green gases", killing anything that got caught in it.

Hendricks breathed in some of the gas... By the time he got back, he was practically dead. Within a few hours he was hissing, trying to choke the life out of me. I reached for the closest thing I could and plunged it into his eye.


We thought DC was hit bad, but at least it was quick. Whatever happened here after the war, it can't have been good and I fear for the worst if it begins to spread outwards.

entries.title: January
entries.text:
We're evacuating the building.

Some kind of explosion or earthquake, unsure if nuclear, has caused the nearby hillside to collapse and now there's some kind of red storm in the sky.

Thankfully the building wasn't caught in the collapse, but we've decided it's no longer safe.

We're going to try heading north.

entries.text:
Dear Slumber Mill Motel,

I am looking for compensation from the company due to an incident that occurred whilst staying at your "Motel". 

A wild bird entered our room via a poorly fitted ventilation shaft and made a nest in my wig collection. 

Due to the bird's protective status in the park, I was informed by a park ranger I am unable to move it under the threat of a fine. These wigs cost me a fortune and I expect to be compensated for them.

entries.title: Deceased Guest in Hotel Room
entries.text:
Title:
Deceased Guest in Hotel Room

Summary:
Jenny, the maid, found a deceased guest in one of the rooms this morning. She contacted the police immediately and they've cordoned off the room for their investigation. Jenny has been sent home for the rest of the week.

The guest participated in the casino's poker tournament and was last seen heading to their room after 9pm. Multiple staff members have stated that the guest lost a substantial amount of money and seemed on edge. If anybody has any additional information, please speak to one of the police officers assigned to the hotel.  

The sooner this is wrapped up, the sooner we can schedule a deep clean of the room.

entries.title: Bizarre Check-Out Discovery
entries.text:
Title: 
Bizarre Check-Out Discovery

Summary:
A female hotel guest checked in on Friday and departed on Sunday afternoon, spending the entirety of her two-day stay confined to her room, only briefly leaving to fetch ice. Upon her checkout, the cleaning staff entered the room as scheduled and encountered an array of peculiar items left behind:

A fully dressed mannequin, decked out in ski gear, was discovered lying in bed beneath a blanket.

A note accompanied the scene stating, "Wrap up warm, looks like ice tonight.".

A photograph was found featuring the mannequin in the shower, taken from an unusual angle through the door frame.

In response to all this, the cleaning team was instructed to conduct a deep clean of the room, disposing of the remaining items around the back. The nature of the discoveries left all of us curious as to what might of happened here, but a collective decision was made not to delve into the mysteries surrounding the guest's choices due to fear of what we might find.

entries.title: Strip Poker Incident
entries.text:
Title:
Strip Poker Incident

Summary:
ALL STAFF are required to alert casino security about guests who are starting to become disruptive. We want to avoid a repeat of the strip poker incident. 

Both hotel and casino staff allowed Mr Morrison's hijinks to continue for too long before intervening. Also, be vigilant for signs of people using the games we provide as a way of indulging in indecent behavior. The shout of "All in must mean all off!" is burned into my mind and I think we'd all benefit if we don't have to see that ever again.

entries.title: 09/02 - Was this a mistake?
entries.text:
Maybe accepting this job from Mr. Stolz was the wrong decision?

It was all so sudden. Moved in the Vault so early to work on the defense systems, leaving my family behind, and resigning from my rather lucrative job at Robco. But it was made clear that he needed my abilities in neurology and cybernetics to create a better tomorrow underground.

Also with them promising me a spot underground when the bombs finally do come, what could I say?

entries.title: 09/21 - Not what I expected
entries.text:
Sigh... 

I think I have an oddball for a boss. I guess the truly affluent think parroting quotes from philosophers and historic figures is a sign of prestige or something?  I mean, it's a murder bot... I don't see why it needs to speak at all.

Not how I expected this to go, but at least I got a spot in a Vault before the bombs inevitably drop. Once I get this done, maybe I can finally find a project worthy of my talents?

entries.title: 11/12 - MORE re-writes?!
entries.text:
They want another rewrite, again?!

This is the third time now! Too patriotic?! Too recent history?! Are you kidding me!!!

It's a murder machine at the end of the world, not some fancy poet you're going to show off to the public or your rich party friends at the end of the world!

Fine, you want inspiring quotes? Pompous silver spooned pseudo intellectual rich elites just love literary scholars, presidents, philosophers, famous generals and the like. Let's get ridiculous then!



Working on this is giving me a migraine. I'm even breaking out in hives! The stress must be making me sick.

entries.title: 11/13 - Really?
entries.text:
They liked it?

Don't get me wrong, I'm happy this is finally over, the whole ordeal has been draining, making me ill in fact. The stress has been making me literally lose my hair!

But, really? THAT actually worked? I wrote it half as a joke... but I guess I was spot on about the tastes of rich pseudo intellectuals. Not like I care that the robot is going on to spouting nonsense as it does its purpose, but the whole thing is completely ridiculous.




Oh well, nevermind all that. The end to this joke of an assignment is nearly in sight! I just need to finish up a few things and I can then finally be assigned something different.

entries.title: 11/22 - Vault-Tec had one job!
entries.text:
Vault-Tec had one job!

Apparently everyone has been exposed to a radiation leak... all because Vault-Tec and Overseer Stolz did a shoddy job somewhere re-enforcing this place!

People have been getting sick. I'm damn sick! I thought the stress was causing an ulcer, the rash, the hair loss, the bleeding!!! Now we all know better...

In the morning I need hunt down some Rad-Away and Rad-X before everyone raids the supplies.

Feeling too weak, just need a little shut-eye, gather some energy before that.

Bright side, at least with the work finished, I can get patched up and chase up my work reassignment tomorrow. At long last, finally I can get work worthy of my talents now they have their ridiculous scholarly sounding murder bot yammering away.
